# Best Pool Hotels

> Independent editorial guide to the world's best hotel pools. We rank hotels with a pool-first methodology (Pool Score 0–10) blended with live guest ratings from Google and TripAdvisor (Meta Rating 0–100). No sponsored placements.

## Pages

- [Home](/): Overview of the world's best pool hotels, by city.
- [Live rankings](/rankings): Live, continuously-updated ranking of every hotel we track.
- [About & method](/about): How Pool Score and Meta Rating work.
- [Affiliate disclosure](/disclosure): How affiliate links work on the site.
- [Cookies](/cookies): Cookie usage.
- [Privacy policy](/integritetspolicy): Privacy policy.
